title: Conditional κ = 0.001612722852614221: improved owner map for the PR596 hyperplane-ended witness
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001612722852614221**. This is +1.48e-9 over our PR596 (0.0016127213726553). The conservative model gives 0.001612722849763179.

This PR has the same construction, providers, dispatch (ck ×53, atm3 ×19) and verifier as PR596. Only the literal owner map changes: a 2-swap ejection chain on idle remainders turns {1:1,3:281,12:1} into {1:2,3:279,5:1,12:1}. The concave moment cost favours uneven holes. The package also ships the declarative inputs `data/WITNESS.json` (inputs only) and `data/EXPECTED.json` (expected values, generated by recomputation), plus a definition-first `README.md`. `data/cand.json` is the search-side candidate description; its warm-start owner map is shipped as `data/search/WARM-OWNERS.json.gz` (a search input that the verifiers do not read).

This PR has the same construction, providers, build steps and verifier as PR591. Only the dispatch and the literal owner map change: ck ×53 and atm3 ×19 calls, all with hyperplane-ended helpers (PR591 used ck ×66, atm3 ×5, jp8 ×1). The LP upper bound for this menu is κ ≤ 0.0016127416, and this map is within 2.2e-8 of it.

This PR keeps PR588's construction (PR582's three providers with all eight frame coalescences) and adds **hyperplane-ended helpers**. In each of the three providers (here ck and atm3), 38 entering width-8 helpers per call have exactly one cleanup gate `h -= p`, where p is a partner whose final frame and h's final frame span a hyperplane U (dim 8). That gate commutes to the end of part B at frame U. The helper then ends at U instead of FULL, so its residual width drops from 8 to 7: local profile {1:+3, 2:−2} per helper, mass-neutral, deficit unchanged at 2560. The width-7 helpers then pair exactly with width-9 helpers in rank-16 owner slots, filling forced rank-3 holes.

**Why this is legitimate.** Ending at FULL is a convention of the inherited code, not a proof obligation:
- Lean Lemma A's hypothesis (F) is stated on actual extended labels and never names FULL.
- Lemma C and Lemma G need only invertible common labels.
- The nested-children lemma gives T_U T_E^{-1} = L(C_[|U|−|E|]⊗I)R with rank-zero L and R.

The full argument and every changed assertion are in `PROOF-HYPERPLANE-END.md`. An independent review found one real issue: the pre-wrapper recipe was ambiguous at three entrances shared by FULL-ended and U-ended helpers. It is fixed, and both wrappers are now keyed by (start, final).

**Verifier changes.**
- Helper width is computed as |final| − |E| at all 9 global sites that previously hard-coded 9 − |E|.
- A per-site revert control puts back the old formula at each site, and each one must fail. All 9 are rejected, the invoice site through a mandatory terminal-codimension check.
- The new typed build step `hyperplane_end` checks commutation, exact scalar replay, the wrapped product L^{-1}T_U T_E^{-1}R^{-1} = C_[7]⊗I (global phase included), widths, and cleanup. It carries replay, wrapper and raw-word negative controls.

The literal owner map (all-HPE dispatch) was found by an RINS-bounded MIP around the pattern LP vertex, within 2e-5 objective units of the LP bound. The paid profile is the global profile recorded in `data/EXPECTED.json`.

## How it was found

- An LP/MILP screen over free dispatch of {ck, atm3, jp8, e8} gave an upper bound of 0.0016015477. The integer solution chose 66/5/1.
- The owner map comes from an exact-window MILP with the dispatch fixed, warm-started from PR571's owner map. Every solution of that model expands literally through Kőnig colouring, and HiGHS solved it to optimality.

## Package

`research/complex-571-hpeq6/` contains 33 files. Five sources are pinned externally by manifest and file hashes, and nothing is copied from them:
- PR568 (`research/complex-multicold`, `71c99ac`);
- PR569 (`research/larger-gain`, `897213a`);
- PR571 (`research/structural-gain`, `b7bdc5a`);
- PR575 (`research/complex-joint-prefix`, `eac6f7e`);
- PR583 (`research/kernel-frame-coalescing`, `89be768`).

The package is fully data-driven. `data/SPEC.json` describes each provider as a typed chain of build steps (pinned base word, then `promote`, `greedy_kernels`, `joint_prefix`, `frame_coalesce`, `gate_move_coalesce` or `hyperplane_end`, each with its paired omission and coverage audits), plus the dispatch, the owner and plan hashes, and every expected value. The single `verify.py` and `code/` contain no witness constants. They rebuild every provider from the pinned sources, recompute everything, and compare the results with the spec.

## Verification

PR568, PR569, PR571 and PR575 are not merged, so fetch their pinned commits first:

```sh
git fetch origin pull/568/head:pr568 pull/569/head:pr569 pull/571/head:pr571 pull/575/head:pr575 pull/583/head:pr583
for n in 568:71c99ac935a33bb7b59a1b4a7af8725a939b0b90 569:897213a855b7fb8a1b8b0e552a2f5c42e6c1b326 \
         571:b7bdc5a8de18fcf418cfb9c7d83a2b1097a5e4a3 575:eac6f7e 583:89be768; do git worktree add --detach ../pr${n%%:*} ${n#*:}; done
python3 -B research/complex-571-hpeq6/verify.py --work /tmp/571-hpeq6 \
  --source multicold=../pr568/research/complex-multicold \
  --source larger_gain=../pr569/research/larger-gain \
  --source structural_gain=../pr571/research/structural-gain \
  --source joint_prefix=../pr575/research/complex-joint-prefix \
  --source frame_coalescing=../pr583/research/kernel-frame-coalescing
```

Add `--check-pins` to check only the package and source pins.

`verify.py` uses only the standard library. It runs:
- the full PR558 replay;
- each provider's build chain, with all of its omission controls (PR568 multi-cut kernels, PR569 promotions, PR575 joint-prefix coverage and rank-five audits);
- the native chain and exact phase edges for all three providers;
- binding, the physical owner audit (31 mutants), a fresh invoice, both exact moment engines, the 47 strict outer inequalities for each model, 147 assembly controls, and the phase-timing controls.

Local result (Windows, CPython 3.11.11): the commit was preflighted from a fresh clone first (byte-identical to the generated package, committed blobs equal its MANIFEST, pin check passes, `spec.py check` OK). The official run from that clean clone then gave `PASS_HPEQ6_NATIVE_COMPLEX_AND_CITED_BIT`, κ 0.001612722852614221, 32/32 stages exit 0, 323 s, with no reused baseline or locals. The receipt records MANIFEST sha256 cac3d56d…, equal to the committed MANIFEST.

GitHub CI has not run, and I make no claim about it.

## Scope

The result is conditional on the inherited all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape/exact recovery, analytic transfer and the bit H1–H5 assumptions. It is finite exact evidence. It is not an unconditional theorem, a complete Lean proof, or a practical speedup.
